# Fixture layout

Fixtures are separated by test level. Most active fixtures are generated by
`tests/conftest.py` in pytest temporary directories so normal runs leave the
checkout untouched.

- `unit/`: notes for isolated parser and mathematical fixtures.
- `integration/`: notes for tiny native-component inputs.
- `e2e/`: provenance-only end-to-end references.

Static files should be added only when generating them would obscure their
scientific meaning or when they preserve a stable external reference.
